sources.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
sources.title: al-Iʿjāz al-bayānī li-l-Qurʾān wa-masāʾil Ibn al-Azraq: dirāsa qurʾāniyya lughawiyya wa-bayāniyya
sources.edition: Dār al-Maʿārif, 3rd ed., 1 vol (Shamela HTML export, numbering follows the print)
sources.source_notes: al-Khūlī school (user's major voice). Part 1: the Qurʾān's bayānī iʿjāz, an inductive study of the openings of surahs, of word meanings (no two words synonymous) and of style; part 2: the questions of Nāfiʿ b. al-Azraq to Ibn ʿAbbās on Qurʾānic words, studied against Qurʾānic usage. Typed Shamela text; no scan of this edition is held yet (archive.org has scans, e.g. item 20240603_20240603_1926): quote with the caveat.
